### One spark, four specialized workshops:
* 🌐 **[Web Engineering](https://jp3n-dwelling.pages.dev)**: Static-first Astro architecture, CSS scroll-driven animations, zero-cookie compliance.
* 🎨 **Graphic Systems**: Modular identity tokens, fluid typography, high-contrast flat color hierarchies.
* ⚡ **Motion Craft**: Advanced After Effects scripting, UI physics, and cinematic canvas animation.
* 🛠️ **Open Source Tooling**: Zero-overhead browser utilities, Web Worker binary parsers, and developer engines.
